'''Ynysdail''' is an island located north of [[Gwenith]]. It requires 73 [[Sailing]] {{boostable|n}} to [[Mooring point|moor]] onto. As Ynysdail is surrounded by [[crystal-flecked waters]], the player will need a boat equipped with an [[adamant keel]] or better to safely sail to the island. 

It has a [[Cave entrance (Ynysdail Cavern)|cave entrance]] leading to [[Ynysdail Cavern]], which contains [[Aquanites]] and [[mithril rocks|mithril]], [[adamantite rocks|adamantite]] and [[runite rocks|runite]] rocks.

Digging right next to the mooring point will give a [[Small key (Ynysdail)|small key]], which unlocks the lockbox on [[Lledrith Island]] containing the [[Dragon salvaging hook schematic]].

There is also a [[Reinforced chest]] on the island.

A [[Rowboat space (amenity)|rowboat]] space can be built on the island. Upon being built, the player can travel to and from the island from [[Gwenith]]. Using the rowboat additionally requires completion of [[Song of the Elves]].

==Transportation==
Players can embark from various nearby [[Mooring point|ports]] when sailing to Ynysdail. Using a [[skiff]] will make it easier to navigate tight spaces and the numerous obstacles in [[Porth Gwenith]] and along the coastline. Players can also reach the area directly around Ynysdail by sailing through the green portal to the east of [[Lledrith Island]]. Building the rowboat shortcut on Ynysdail will allow players to easily reach it from [[Gwenith]] without needing to sail.

Note: The player will need a boat equipped with an [[adamant keel]] if sailing.

* Teleport to [[Prifddinas]], exit north towards Gwenith, and take the [[Rowboat space (amenity)|rowboat]] if built (after completion of [[Song of the Elves]])
* [[Piscatoris teleport]] to the [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]], use [[Summon Boat]] to teleport your boat to you (note that there is no [[Shipwright]] to retrieve your boat at this location), then sail south
* [[Sailors' amulet|Sailor's amulet]] teleport to [[Port Roberts]], summon your boat (or pay Shipwright), then sail north east
* Go to [[Port Piscarilius]], summon your boat (or pay Shipwright), then sail south east
* Teleport to [[Civitas illa Fortis|Civitas]], summon your boat (or pay Shipwright), then sail north east

==Thieving==
The [[reinforced chest]] on the island can be thieved from. It requires 76 [[Thieving]] to picklock. It is a good source of [[Umbral frag|umbral frags]] which are used for farming [[umbral coral]]. The coral is used to make [[Armadyl brew]].

The chest is easy to get to via [[Prifddinas]] after the row boat has been built.
